m: {Pikachu} scampers {Inside} the {Jungle} and fires Thunderbolts into a hollow log, each crackle thumping out a *drumbeat* that spells a surname. {Batman} glides {Inside} the {Spa}, brooding over a *pulled weed* that has grown back through the mud bath. {Pikachu} hides in the {Bathroom} of the {Yen Exchange} behind a fake *nameboard* reading HONEST TELLER, sparking his cheeks until bottle caps glow like gold. He squeaks an innocent "Pika!" and uses them to **cheat** a *horse* in a green visor out of its savings. The glow fades, the *horse* kicks down the *nameboard*, and the tiny **cheat** climbs into his Poké Ball and shuts the lid.

{Frodo} limps into the {Bathroom} of the {Jungle} after a very long walk, and a *small table* bursts into flames beside him. He slips on the Ring to hide, but his invisible *right hand* brushes the ashes and a blazing **phoenix** rises out of them. The **phoenix** sees him anyway, sneezes sparks and settles on his head, and he sighs that he never wanted to carry this either.

{Homer} naps in the {Bathroom} of the {Waiting Room} with a doughnut on his chest until a *broom* starts sweeping by itself, brushing the crumbs off his *heart*. With every stroke his dim schemes blow away and he grows terrifyingly **wise**, explaining the universe to a plunger. Then the *heart* begs for the doughnut, he says "Mmm…", and the man who was **wise** for nine seconds is gone.

{Mario} leaps {Inside} the {Lake} and head-butts a floating block, but instead of a coin out pops a *woman* holding a giant *plum* like a microphone. She shouts into the *plum* and the question booms across the water. Every block he hits now releases more of the **media**, cameras flashing, so with one "Wahoo!" he dives down a warp pipe to escape the **media**.

{Pikachu} bursts into the {Bathroom} of the {Lake} and hits a *standing person* with a full Thunderbolt, and the *standing person* does not even blink, though every hair now points at the ceiling. Pikachu's ears droop and his cheeks stop fizzing, for he can only **admire** such calm. "Pika…" he breathes, climbs into a Poké Ball by himself, and hands it over to the one he will always **admire**.

{Frodo} trudges into the {Bathroom} of the {Funfair} while the Ring whispers on its chain, until his *standing heart* glows red with **anger**. The meek little hobbit stamps one hairy foot, the *standing heart* kicks a *fountain*, and the *fountain* spouts boiling steam over the dodgems. Sam gently takes the Ring away, the **anger** drains out, and Frodo apologises to a wet carousel horse.

{Pikachu} crouches in {Front} of the {Pool}, tail twitching, as a *fortune stick* clatters past reading YOU WILL BE CAUGHT. He wiggles and leaps to **pounce** on it, cheeks crackling, just as a giant *helping hand* swoops to **pounce** on him with a Poké Ball. All three hit the deep end with a fizzing bang and one soggy "Pika!"

{Lara Croft} vaults {Inside} the {Boxing Ring}, where a stone crocodile idol sits on a pressure plate and a *herald* trumpets its riddle: name its **age**. She climbs the jaw, ponytail swinging, and counts the *teeth*, one for every century. The *herald* bows at her answer, a rolling boulder just misses her, and the idol grumbles that nobody should ever ask a crocodile its **age**.

{Chewbacca} storms up in {Front} of the {Museum} on a terrified *horse* and roars so loudly that burglars scatter. In a temper he rips a *district map* in two, because one roar can **drive away** only one street at a time and he wants the lot. By noon he has managed to **drive away** the whole quarter, the pigeons and finally the *horse*, which gallops off without him.

{Shrek} glowers in {Front} of the {Beach}, cradling his last strip of *sun-dried meat* and roaring at any gull that comes near. Under all his ogre layers a *standing heart* peels itself free and hugs the strip too, for nothing else in life does he **cherish** so. Donkey asks for one bite and will not shut up, so Shrek wraps it in onion skin to **cherish** for ever.

{Homer} waddles {Inside} the {Tower} with a dim scheme to skip the fire drill by sending a tiny *pig* in a cape to do it for him. The scheme backfires: the *pig* is truly **heroic**, rescuing guards, stamping out sparks and saving his doughnut from a falling beam. "D'oh!" he says, as the crowd carries off the **heroic** *pig* and hands him a broom.

{Yoshi} waddles into the {Basement} of the {Mansion} just as a *sudden flash* bursts from the fuse box and blinds everybody. His sticky tongue swallows the *sudden flash* whole, and he lays it as a giant egg that will not stop blinking. A *helping hand* throws a bedsheet to **cover** it, then a curtain, then a carpet, and Yoshi sits on top to **cover** the last bright crack.

{James Bond} strolls up in {Front} of the {Yen Exchange} carrying *two sheaves* of wheat, and a banker orders him to pick one. "I'll take **both**," he says, unruffled, and clicks a cufflink from Q. The *two sheaves* sprout rotor blades and lift him over the traffic, clutching **both** his wheat and the banker's hat.

{Yoshi} skids into the {Bathroom} of the {Ice Rink} and launches a flutter jump, one *kicking foot* pedalling the air while he yells "Yoshi!". A twirling *dancer* gapes at a **leap** that simply hangs there for a full minute, and the ceiling lights sway as he passes. The *dancer* tries the same **leap**, spins three times and vanishes into a snowbank.

{Sherlock} kneels in {Front} of the {Beehive} over a *lying man* stiff with honey, and deduces from one crumb that this **corpse** expired on Tuesday, of boredom. "Elementary, Watson," he says smugly, and lights his pipe. The *lying man* sneezes, sits up and asks for toast, and Sherlock coolly informs the **corpse** that it is mistaken.

{Sailor Moon} trips into the {Bathroom} of the {Pool} and begins her long sparkly transformation, until a *stern face* on the wall turns to glare. The music dies, the sparkles drop to the tiles, and the room goes **solemn**. She tries her speech about justice, wobbles, and bursts into loud tears, but the *stern face* never blinks, so she finishes in a whisper, tiara drooping, perfectly **solemn**.

{Pikachu} fizzes into the {Bathroom} of the {Spa} wrapped in a *towel*, and his sneeze fires a Thunderbolt that sends the *towel* flying off in terror. A *white dove* flutters down with a tiny **handkerchief** in its beak. He blows his nose with a "Pika-CHOO!", and the **handkerchief** stands on end, fizzing, along with every feather on the dove.

{Sherlock} peers into the {Basement} of the {Beehive} and deduces, from one smear of honey on a *horse*, exactly who ought to **drive**. "Not you, Watson. Elementary." He seizes the reins, the *horse* bolts through the honey tunnels, and a *historian* in the back seat takes notes, proving that no detective in all of history could **drive** this badly.

{Batman} grapples into the {Basement} of the {Tower} and pulls a drill from his utility belt, tunnelling through the *soil* and packing it into walls for a secret **fortress**. The sensors are set, the bats are hung, and he broods in the dark. Then a *nanny* marches straight past every trap, tuts at the mud, and proves no **fortress** can stop bedtime, tucking him in, cape and all.

{James Bond} escapes into the {Bathroom} of the {Yeti Cave} and lands in the annual **session** of the Yeti Parliament, held beside a *sprouting field* that grows one new delegate each year. A *lying man* snores in the speaker's chair, having slept through everything since 1890. Bond straightens his bow tie, fires Q's gavel pen, and says this **session** is now closed.

{Shrek} stomps up in {Front} of the {Inn} wanting only to be left alone, but Donkey tells one joke too many, and a huge *grin* breaks through all his layers. He roars at it to go away, so the *grin* slides off his face and bounces through the windows. Every guest it lands on turns **happy**, and Shrek, to his disgust, stays **happy** till morning.

{Homer} wedges himself in the {Bathroom} of the {Waiting Room} with a box of doughnuts and a dim scheme to finish them unseen. A giant *heart* knocks on the door and asks one **favour**: the last pink doughnut, for a hungry nurse. "Mmm…" he says, and shakily hands it over, the greatest **favour** of his life. The *heart* waddles off and his stomach howls: "D'oh!"

{Cookie Monster} bursts into the {Bathroom} of the {Hut}, googly eyes spinning, and mistakes a *bamboo book* for a very long biscuit. "Me want cookie!" he roars, and the *bamboo book* clacks like castanets as he chews through it in a spray of splinters. All that survives is a tiny **booklet** of recipes, and he reads one line before he eats that **booklet** too.

{Charlie Brown} trudges into the {Basement} of the {Pool} to **store** his winter kites where no tree can ever reach them. A *standing person* takes a careful *headcount* of them, three hundred kites, stacked to the ceiling. "Good grief," he says, as the shelf snaps, and everything he tried to **store** floats away past Snoopy, who is lounging on a lilo.

{Pikachu} waits in {Front} of the {Cat Café} clutching a *ticket* when a gust of *wind* whips it away, and it starts to **flutter** just out of reach. He fires a Thunderbolt after it, and the static makes every napkin, menu and paper bag **flutter** up and cling to his fur. The *wind* lifts him off the pavement, a small yellow kite squeaking "Pika!"

{Sailor Moon} twirls in {Front} of the {Hangar} through her sparkly transformation, and her moon wand misfires, blasting a giant *mulberry* tree up through the lawn. She throws her tiara to chop it down, and a purple rain of **mulberry** fruit splats on every aeroplane and on her uniform. She cries loudly, while Luna the cat sits nearby, calmly licking **mulberry** juice off one paw.

{Shrek} roars everybody out from {Inside} the {Yen Exchange}, slams the *gate* and plants a *tree* in the doorway, so that at last he can be left alone. The bankers stand locked out, and even the coins lie **idle**. He strings a hammock in the branches of the *tree* and stays **idle** with an onion until Donkey squeezes through the bars, talking.

{Cookie Monster} gropes into the {Basement} of the {Mansion} and devours what he thinks are cookies: a jar of bitter *ginseng*. His googly eyes roll, crumbs spray from his mouth, and his *standing heart* sobs into the empty jar. "Me **miserable**!" he wails, reaching for the next jar, which is more *ginseng*. Soon he is a damp blue heap, the most **miserable** monster alive.

{James Bond} strides {Inside} the {Yeti Cave} and twists a *lucky charm* from Q, whose one absurd function is firing *water drops* at tremendous pressure. Every hairy yeti gets scrubbed until it sparkles, and the cave turns so **clean** it squeaks. The yetis shake themselves dry, and Bond, tuxedo spotless, remarks, "Shaken, not stirred, and perfectly **clean**."

{Zorro} dashes away laughing in {Front} of the {Lagoon}, but he cannot resist slashing a Z into everything he passes. The soldiers follow each **trace**: a Z on a palm, a Z on a duck, a muddy print from his *kicking foot*. It all leads to an *ancestral hall*, which creaks open on a hundred portraits, each with a fresh Z, the last **trace** of him.

{Batman} glides {Inside} the {Fort}, a sad ruin, and snags a passing *comet* with his grappling hook. A *strong arm* springs from his utility belt and plants it in the courtyard like a seed. Shops, gardens and cheering crowds burst up around the glow, a **thriving** town in seconds, and Batman growls gloomily that a **thriving** place has no need of him.

{Batman} drops from the sky in {Front} of the {Inn} and, in his gruffest voice, interrogates the *guest of honour*, a goat in a crown. Finding no crimes, he produces a red carpet and a cake from his utility belt, because Alfred insists a **guest** must be treated well. The goat eats both, then starts on the cape, and Batman broods over the worst **guest** in Gotham.

{Pikachu} creeps {Inside} the {Inn}, and every *step* on the staircase hides a Poké Ball that snaps him up, so he pops back out with a furious "Pika!". A trainer turns a *page* in a notebook to mark each capture, for it happens **frequently**. He is caught so **frequently** that sparks set the *page* smoking and he never reaches the second floor.

{Charlie Brown} runs {Inside} the {Boathouse} to kick the football, and a *standing person* flicks it away with a *crowbar* for the thousandth time. Flat on his back in his zigzag shirt, he feels pure **hatred** rise for the first time ever. He leaps up and glares, the *crowbar* clangs, a canoe falls on him, and "Good grief" is all that remains of his **hatred**.

{Mario} leaps {Inside} the {Fort} and stomps on a round *stone*, which spins like a kicked shell across a heap of *hemp*. "Wahoo!" Every stomp makes it **grind** the fibres finer, and a coin pops out with each dusty puff. He collects so many that he stays all day to **grind**, moustache full of fluff, while the guards sneeze in unison.

{Darth Vader} breathes loudly in the {Bathroom} of the {Beach} and booms at his *little brother* to **hand over** the TV remote. The boy bolts away down a sandy *road*, so Vader raises one glove and the Force tugs at the buttons. "I am your brother," he booms, deeply disappointed, and the boy sulkily begins to **hand over** the remote, one button at a time.

{Shrek} stomps {Inside} the {Yeti Cave} wanting peace and finds an **evil** yeti cackling over his stolen onions, one huge *fang* glinting in the dark. Shrek roars so loudly that the *hillside* shudders and the *fang* pops out and bounces away. Now the **evil** yeti can only lisp his threats, and Donkey will not stop imitating him.

The {Joker} rigs a prank in the {Bathroom} of the {Swamp}, a spring-loaded *helping hand* in a joke box, and cackles as he opens it himself by mistake. It shoves him straight at a *schoolkid* on a lily pad, and they **bump into** each other in a splash of trick cards. The *schoolkid* squirts his flower right back, and soon the frogs all **bump into** each other too.

{Naruto} crouches in the {Basement} of the {Beach} and summons a hundred shadow clones to **draft** a battle plan against the sandcastle over the bay. Each clone lends a *helping hand*, gripping a *tool* as a pencil and yelling over the rest. A hundred pages later, every **draft** says exactly the same thing: eat ramen first, and never give up.

{Gandalf} arrives in the {Basement} of the {Casino} exactly when he means to and mutters a spell at the dice. His staff spits sparks, the *water drops* on the ceiling harden into marbles, and a *royal robe* on a chair bundles itself into a ball. Everything begins to **roll**, chips and croupiers alike, and he thunders "You shall not pass!" as the lot continue to **roll** straight past him.

{Zorro} swings on a chandelier into the {Bathroom} of the {Boathouse} and slashes a Z across a *spring planter* of tulips. Each tulip flicks open like a trumpet and begins to **play music** aimed at the *sky*, which thunders back a drum roll. He conducts with his rapier, the ducks **play music** on the oars, and he vanishes laughing before the final chord.

{Shrek} marches {Inside} the {Dunes} on a one-ogre **patrol** to keep trespassers off his land, roaring at every cactus, with Donkey trotting behind and never shutting up. The *road* loops back on itself, and a *wavy river* of sand carries off all his KEEP OUT signs. So he grumbles, peels an onion, and sets off on **patrol** again.

{Yoshi} scampers {Inside} the {Mansion}, flicks out his tongue and swallows a *page* of paint samples from the hand of a dapper *gentleman*. He lays egg after egg, each one a new **colour**, and they burst against the walls like fireworks. "Yoshi!" he chirps, and the *gentleman*, splattered from hat to spats, faints in every **colour** at once.

{James Bond} strolls into the {Bathroom} of the {Beach} with a sniffle, and Q's newest gadget, a *standing knife*, springs from his shoe and carves a *trimmed hedge* into a pill the size of a car. "One **dose**, shaken, not stirred," he says, unruffled. He rolls the whole **dose** down his throat somehow, straightens his bow tie and sneezes out a single leaf.

{James Bond} is cornered in the {Bathroom} of the {Beach} by a *debt collector* reading out the cost of every tuxedo he has ruined. Unruffled, he pulls a *silk thread* from his cuff, Q's gadget, and it whirls round the man until he is tied in a neat bow. Slipping away unpaid is a rare **achievement**, so he pins a medal on himself for that **achievement**.

{Gandalf} arrives in the {Bathroom} of the {Lagoon} and slams his staff on a *workbench*, crankily announcing that everyone must **contribute** to a great statue of a whale. A spell sends one *shell* flying from every creature in the water, clattering into place. Fish grumble, crabs salute, and he himself chooses to **contribute** a burst of fireworks, which sets the statue afloat.

{Frodo} collapses in {Front} of the {Jungle} onto a *sickbed*, and the Ring keeps whispering till he goes **crazy**. On it goes and he vanishes, off it comes and he giggles, on, off, on, as a hot *wind* spins the *sickbed* round on its wheels. Sam runs after him with soup, shouting, until the monkeys catch it and go **crazy** too.

{Pikachu} fires a Thunderbolt in {Front} of the {Fort} and the blast heaps the *soil* into a steep **slope**. He hops onto a *hide*, cheeks fizzing, and whooshes down squeaking "Pika!" with cannonballs bouncing after him. At the bottom a trainer waits, Poké Ball ready, but the *hide* flips and flings him straight back up the **slope**.

{Chewbacca} ducks {Inside} the {Cat Café} to fix a sizzling *barbecue*, rips off its lid, and a giant *eye* on a stalk pops out of the grill. He lets out a long growl that only friends understand, and it means **look**. No cat understands, so he roars it again, louder, **look**, until the *eye* swivels round and every whisker in the room turns to stare.

{James Bond} skis {Inside} the {Yeti Cave} with a furious yeti behind him and presses a button on Q's ski pole, which shoots out into a long *lance*. A *sparrow* perches on the tip and pecks at his aim, and the *lance* swings up, snaps an icicle, and drops it to **cut off** the yeti's path. "Sorry to **cut off** the conversation," he says, skiing on.

{Robocop} clanks {Inside} the {Mansion} and his targeting display locks onto a tiny illegal *campfire* on the rug. He reads aloud a directive forbidding citizens to **ignite** anything, but a spark from his steel arm lands on the curtains. As *flames* leap to the piano, he politely places each one under arrest, while the chandelier behind him begins to **ignite**.

{James Bond} aims his wristwatch in {Front} of the {Cat Café}, and Q's tiny laser, which does nothing else, turns every sausage on a *barbecue* to charcoal. The cats sniff the **burnt** heap and sneeze soot over the tablecloth. Bond, unruffled, spears one and takes a bite. "**Burnt**," he says, "not stirred."

{Darth Vader} strides into the {Bathroom} of the {Yen Exchange}, which he has ordered rebuilt as a golden **palace hall**, his breathing echoing off the columns. With one glove he lifts a *throne* through the air and sits. A manager charges with a *war club*, Vader Force-chokes the club until it squeaks, and he booms that this **palace hall** does not please him.

{Walter White} knocks in the {Basement} of the {Lake} house, where a *standing person* in a grey costume and an *elephant handler* swear their beast is real. Proud of his precise science, he drips iodine from a beaker onto the trunk, and it turns blue-black. "Starch," he says, adjusting his glasses: the elephant is a **fake** made of potatoes, and the handler is a **fake** too.

{Lara Croft} climbs into the {Basement} of the {Youth Hostel} and slots a relic into a *mortise* in the wall, solving the ancient puzzle. A *tree* erupts through the floor, its long branches drooping like hair: a weeping **willow**, sobbing over the bunk beds. She swings across on it, ponytail tangled in the leaves, as the **willow** wails so loudly that a boulder starts rolling.

{Sailor Moon} stumbles into the {Basement} of the {Warehouse}, trips over a pile of *gold coins*, and each coin snaps shut round her ankle like a tiny **lock**. She makes a long speech about justice, waves her wand and twirls through her whole transformation, but the *gold coins* just clink. She cries loudly until Luna the cat strolls up and picks the **lock** with one claw.

{Batman} looms in {Front} of the {Beach} over a crooked crab, growling that he will **force** the truth out of it. He hurls a batarang at a *full jar* of jam, which thunders down the *road* behind the crab, herding it towards the sea. With sticky doom rolling closer, one gruff whisper is enough to **force** a confession about the missing sandcastle.

{Pikachu} sprawls on an animal *hide* in {Front} of the {Fort} and reads a *page* of poetry aloud, using only the word "Pika". The cannon crew nods: **quite** good. He adds sparks for the rhymes, the *hide* stands on end, the *page* begins to smoke, and the soldiers declare themselves **quite** moved, and also tingling.

{Homer} slumps in {Front} of the {Casino} as *twilight* turns the sky the exact pink of a sprinkled doughnut. "Mmm…" he says, reaching up, and he grows so dizzy with hunger that he begins to **faint**. The *twilight* deepens, a round moon rises like an even bigger doughnut, and he comes round, sees it, and goes down for another **faint**.

{Chewbacca} squeezes into the {Bathroom} of the {Mint} to **urge** a stalled coin press back to life with long, loving growls that only friends understand. His *right hand* pats its side and his *strong arm* gives it a hefty shove. The press purrs and starts stamping, and every broken machine in the building lines up for him to **urge** it on too.

{Charlie Brown} trudges {Inside} the {Jungle} to **present** his *petition* against kite-eating trees to the gorilla king. On the very last step a tree leans down, snatches the *petition* and swallows it. "Good grief," he says, and bows, and has to **present** an empty silver tray while Snoopy, behind him, collects a medal.

{Sailor Moon} weeps in {Front} of the {Boathouse} because an *elder* has lost his false teeth, and she vows justice in a long sparkly speech. Her wand fails as a detector, so a *helping hand* joins her to **search** every net, barrel and gull. They **search** until sunset, Luna sighing, and then the *elder* grins: the teeth were in his mouth, and she wails all over again.

{Chewbacca} crawls {Inside} the {Inn} with tools in his bandolier and starts fixing everything, because a loyal Wookiee cannot sit still. His *strong arm* mends the boiler, the stairs and the door before dawn: **hardworking** does not begin to describe it. Even a *violet* on the windowsill sprouts tiny spanners and joins in, as **hardworking** as he is, while he growls at Han to get up.

{James Bond} slinks into the {Bathroom} of the {Yeti Cave}, where a yeti *sentry* has orders to make him **give up** gadgets for good. One by one the *sentry* confiscates his exploding pen, his laser cufflink and his singing tie. Unruffled, Bond remarks he would sooner **give up** breathing, taps his heel, and his shoe walks him out through the wall.

{James Bond} crashes into the {Bathroom} of the {Piazza} and leaps onto a *horse* with a big *plus sign* on its rump, assuming it is Q's latest. He presses the *plus sign* and another *horse* appears, then another, all harnessed together. Unruffled, he shoots his cuffs and takes the reins, for only he could **drive** forty horses in a tuxedo, and he will **drive** them twice round the fountain.

{Pikachu} primps in the {Bathroom} of the {Cat Café}, clutching a *ticket* to a Pokémon beauty contest. He flicks *water drops* onto his red cheeks, every spark making them twinkle, and the mirror sighs at how **pretty** he is. "Pika!" he poses, tail high, and the cats swoon. A trainer simply walks up and catches him, because he is too **pretty** to run.

{Yoshi} follows his nose into the {Basement} of the {Inn} and slurps up a *side dish* of salty peanuts. His thirst stretches his *yawn* so wide that his tongue uncurls and takes one enormous **drink** from a barrel of tea. He lays the whole barrel as a giant sloshing egg, and the innkeeper taps it and serves the next **drink** from the shell.

{Cookie Monster} thunders {Inside} the {Tower} and spots a wooden *trough* heaped with biscuits at the feet of General **Cao**, whose name is stitched across his armour. "Me want cookie!" he roars, and the *trough* vanishes in a spray of crumbs and splinters. He eats the general's name badge too, then looks up, googly eyes sorry: "Me burp, General **Cao**."

{Darth Vader} marches into the {Basement} of the {Warehouse}, breathing loudly, and finds a single *flower* growing out of a crack in the dark. He ignites his red lightsaber, and the **flower** does not flinch. "I find your petals disturbing," he booms, and lifts it with the Force, but the **flower** keeps blooming, until he tucks it under his helmet, where nobody can see.

{Zorro} swings on a chandelier into the {Basement} of the {Beehive}, where a lion *cub* sleeps in a blanket among ten thousand dozing bees. Being **careful** is not his habit, but he draws his rapier and, tongue out, cuts one tiny Z into the blanket's hem. The *cub* sneezes, the bees stir, and he vanishes with a **careful**, very quiet laugh.

{Robocop} clanks {Inside} the {Boathouse} and politely reads a *springy twig* its rights. The twig bends, bounces and tickles his steel chest, and his targeting display flashes an error as his armour goes **soft** as jelly. He wobbles into a canoe, hugs a pillow, and announces a new directive: arrest nothing that is not **soft**.

{Lara Croft} flips into the {Basement} of the {Piazza} and faces an ancient trap: a *balance scale* that opens the tomb door only for **two**. She grabs a *standing person* gawping nearby, somersaults them both on board, and the *balance scale* settles dead level at exactly **two**. The door grinds open, a pigeon lands on her ponytail, and the boulder starts rolling.

{Mario} pops out of a warp pipe in the {Bathroom} of the {Jungle}, head-butts a block, and instead of a coin down falls the *firstborn* baby of the **Meng** family, swaddled in leaves. "Wahoo!" He feeds the *firstborn* a mushroom, and the child shoots up past the treetops. Monkeys bow by the hundred to enormous young **Meng**, heir of the whole jungle.

{Frodo} limps into the {Basement} of the {Pool} after a very long walk, and finds a tiny *mansion* built entirely of *meat*. Faint with hunger, he steps up to it, and one bare hairy toe sinks right through a green, fuzzy wall: completely **rotten**. Sam sniffs and says even the road to Mordor smelled better, and the **rotten** *mansion* sags with a sigh.

{Yoshi} licks up a silk *cocoon* in the {Bathroom} of the {Boathouse}, swallows it, and lays it as an egg. A tiny *strong arm* punches through the shell, and out wriggles a caterpillar in a nappy, so **young** it still wears the eggshell as a hat. It flexes, calls him mum, and rows off in a boat, and Yoshi flutter-jumps after the **young** champion in alarm.

{James Bond} surfaces in the {Bathroom} of the {Yen Exchange} with a perfect plan and Q's shoes. {Darth Vader} marches in {Front} of the {Yeti Cave} breathing loudly when a *lost arrow* whizzes past and pins his cape, and his *kicking foot* catches on a rock. {Lara Croft} vaults {Inside} the {Warehouse} to **patrol** a *road* of conveyor belts lined with stolen relics that keep trying to escape in their crates. {Mario} drops into the {Bathroom} of the {Island}, sees a glowing *stream* under the *moon*, and being a plumber, grabs it like a leaky pipe. {Mario} climbs out of a pipe into the {Bathroom} of the {Tower}, where a sheet shows the *silhouette* of a princess in distress. {Yoshi} wanders into the {Bathroom} of the {Museum} and is thrown in **prison** by a *prowling dog* with a ring of keys. {Lara Croft} swings {Inside} the {Yen Exchange} as a *herald* announces that a tiny relic coin has lain alone for three thousand years. Tough as she is, her *standing heart* melts with **pity**. {Tarzan} swings on a vine {Inside} the {Tower} and, baffled by civilisation, asks a shelf of *pottery* in ape-speech where it lives. It does not answer, so he wears a teapot as a hat. {Sherlock} peers into the {Bathroom} of the {Boathouse} and, from a single wet hair under his magnifying glass, deduces an enormous **beast**. {Darth Vader} breathes loudly in the {Bathroom} of the {Island} and, with one raised glove, floats a giant *shell* of pearls away from a crab, calling it a **loan**. {Charlie Brown} stands in {Front} of the {Hangar} under a *double sun*, two blazing suns side by side, and everyone around him booms. {Tarzan} swings into the {Basement} of the {Hangar} and, baffled by a fallen *attic* with a mattress spilling from it, asks a passing ape what it is for. The ape shows him how to **lie down**.
